title: peer_whitelist doc: invalid CIDR described as fatal startup error but is a parse error
description: config.rs lines 45-49: peer_whitelist field doc says invalid CIDR is a fatal startup error. It is actually a ConfigError::Parse from serde deserialization, not a Validation error from validate(). A developer auditing validate() would not find CIDR checking there and might add a duplicate check. Fix: clarify it is caught at deserialization.
